name: spring
description: Among the things demonstrated in this project: - Bean Lifecycle - @Configuration/@Bean - Spring Security, including XSS, CSRF, CORS, and SSO with KeyCloak - Hibernate Repository (Spring Data) - @Transactional - Monitoring with Micrometer/Prometheus/Graphana - Caching - @Async, @Scheduled - @EventListener - @ConfigurationProperties- - Aspects - REST Endpoints - GraphQL
